items.title: VODAFONE QATAR ANNOUNCED THE ESTABLISHMENT OF INFINITY SIGNAL SERVICES LLC
items.summary: Doha, Qatar, 29 August 2026 – Vodafone Qatar Q.P.S.C. (Vodafone Qatar or the Company) announced the establishment of Infinity Signal Services LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Vodafone Qatar responsible for the management, operation, and development of the Company’s telecommunications tower assets and passive infrastructure.

items.title: VODAFONE QATAR Q2 2026 EARNINGS RELEASE
items.summary: Doha, Qatar, 28 July 2026: Vodafone Qatar P.Q.S.C. (“Vodafone Qatar” or the “Company”) announced its consolidated financial results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, delivering a strong first half and continued growth across its key financial and operational metrics.

items.title: ANNOUNCEMENT FROM VODAFONE QATAR P.Q.S.C.
items.summary: Doha, Qatar, 27 April 2026 — Vodafone Qatar Q.P.S.C. (“Vodafone Qatar” or the “Company”) announced that it has successfully completed the acquisition of Maktapp LLC (Maktapp QSTP LLC) through its subsidiary Infinity Fintech Ventures LLC, as this step comes as part of the further development of its digital strategy.

items.title: VODAFONE QATAR REPORTS 24% INCREASE IN NET PROFIT TO QR 201 MILLION FOR THE FIRST THREE MONTHS OF 2026
items.summary: Doha, Qatar, 20 April 2026: Vodafone Qatar P.Q.S.C. (“Vodafone Qatar” or the “Company”) today announced its financial results for the three months ended 31 March 2026.

items.title: VODAFONE QATAR HOLDS ITS ANNUAL GENERAL ASSEMBLY MEETING
items.summary: Doha, Qatar - 1 March 2026: Vodafone Qatar P.Q.S.C. (“Vodafone Qatar” or the “Company”) held its Ordinary General Assembly Meeting virtually on Sunday, 1st March 2026 chaired by Vodafone Qatar Chief Executive Officer, Sheikh Hamad Abdulla Jassim Al Thani.

items.title: NOTICE FROM VODAFONE QATAR P.Q.S.C.
items.summary: Doha, Qatar, 1 March 2026 — In light of the current situation and in line with national safety guidance, Vodafone Qatar P.Q.S.C. (the “Company”) has decided to convene its Annual General Assembly (AGA) meeting, scheduled for Sunday, 1st March 2026 at 9:30 p.m., virtually via Zoom video conferencing rather than in person.
